heading: Every format, in and out
_lead_note: Deliberately count-free: the in/out/round-trip numbers are computed live in docs/build.ts from formats-catalog.json's dir fields, so no string in this file may hard-code one.
lead: Lolly reads dozens of source formats and renders dozens more - here's the full set, grouped by what each one is. The {roundtrip} ones are read *and* written, so they sit once in the middle.
